subject: Orchid Labs — pilot allocation & promotional sandbox clearance
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@orchidlabs.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: support@orchidlabs.io
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — Orchid Labs accelerator cohort (sandbox credits)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked great and the team is excited. We’re starting an internal accelerator cohort next month and would love to run a 6-week pilot using Redwood to evaluate end-to-end relevance and throughput.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a promotional sandbox allocation (roughly $10k equivalent) + a two-week trial extension so we can complete our integration tests and a partner demo for investors? We’ll need SOC2 evidence and a short SOW to present to our procurement folks.

Attached: draft SOW and a short product brief.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Best,
Lena Park
Founder & CTO, Orchid Labs
www.orchidlabs.io

Attachments: Orchid_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), product_brief.md (text/markdown)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@orchidlabs.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Orchid Labs accelerator cohort (sandbox credits)

Thanks Lena — great to hear the demo resonated. A few quick items so I can move this through our program routing: 

- Are you a current inbound signup or referred by one of our accelerator partners? (helps with eligibility tiers)
- Can you share anticipated monthly token consumption during the 6-week pilot (rough ballpark)?
- Any restricted data types we should be aware of (PII/PHI)?

From a timing perspective, we can typically do promotional sandbox allocations plus a short trial extension for qualified accelerator cohorts. I’ve looped Marissa (program ops) and Dev (finance/legal) to scope the SOW & procurement checklist.

If it helps, I can propose a concise mutual action plan (1 pager) once we confirm volumes. Want to do a 20-min call Monday morning?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Growth — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0184

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena@orchidlabs.io>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Orchid Labs accelerator cohort (sandbox credits)

Hi Lena — welcome, and congrats on the accelerator.

We reviewed the draft SOW. Program ops is prepared to approve a promotional allocation of $7,500 in sandbox credits plus a two-week trial extension (total pilot window 8 weeks) under the following conditions: 

- Proof of developer contact and integration plan (one pager) submitted to program@redwood.com
- Limited PII only; no PHI or regulated financial data.
- We’ll require a short intake form and a countersigned SOW for procurement (I’ve attached the SOW template).

Dev — can you confirm procurement checklist items (PO threshold / invoicing) and whether SOC2-summary.pdf is sufficient for Orchid’s procurement team?

Lena — if that package works, Ben and I can send the final mutual action plan and DocuSign link by EOD. We can also kick off a technical onboarding session with a Solutions Engineer.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Program Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_template_redwood.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena@orchidlabs.io>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — Orchid Labs accelerator cohort (sandbox credits)

Thanks — quick procurement notes: 

- PO: Orchid’s procurement team will need the SOW + PO for any invoiced components beyond the sandbox. The $7,500 promo is issued as account credits (no invoice), but any overage or reserved capacity will require a PO.
- SOC2: SOC2-summary.pdf is sufficient for initial review; procurement may follow up with a security questionnaire if they have custom controls.
- DocuSign: I’ve uploaded a countersign-ready SOW to the Redwood DocuSign queue. Lena, you’ll get a signing link — please confirm the billing contact and legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the SOW.

Next steps: Ben to send mutual action plan; Marissa to issue sandbox credits once SOW signed and intake form received.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Finance & Contracts — Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com
